modelingNotes: Exact 8579/12-407, R. STAHL SolConeX article 153037: 63 A, 480-500 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 3P+PE (4-pole), black, clock position 7h, screw terminals for one 2.5-16 mm2 finely stranded conductor, IP66 polyamide enclosure, ATEX/IECEx Ex db eb IIC. Installed hardware revision is unverified. The 5-pole 8579/12-5.. (adds N) and any other suffix or successor are not substituted.

Exact -407 coded range is480–500VAC,50/60Hz,63A,black,7h. Family maximum690VAC and insulation750V are capabilities. No voltage maximum is stored as nominal_voltage: that field imposes exact equality in the compiler. Variant range and frequency remain source qualifications.

Manual p.9 diagram 19041E00 (view from front side, 6h reference position) identifies contact markings L1, L2, L3 and the protective-earth symbol for the 4-pole 8579/12-4.. plug; p.10 colour-code table assigns 480-500 V / 50-60 Hz / black / earth-contact-7h to this -407. Diagram inspected visually. No rotated 7h pin coordinates, rear-view layout, numeric pin mapping or installed phase assignment is inferred.

C.L1/C.L2/C.L3/C.PE are cable-side (screw-terminal) functional pole endpoints and M.L1/M.L2/M.L3/M.PE are the corresponding mating pins. L1/L2/L3 are manufacturer contact identities, PE is a textual alias for the earth symbol, and C/M are authoring-side aliases, not stamped terminal numbers. Individual per-contact screw legends and cable-clamp markings are unverified. Verify physical terminal markings before use.

A plug has fixed contact conductors, not switched power poles (contrast the interlocked wall socket). Author four explicit fixed links C.L1-M.L1, C.L2-M.L2, C.L3-M.L3 and C.PE-M.PE representing factory continuity from each screw terminal to its fixed pin (manual p.13: conductor clamped on the contact-pin carrier). The singleton bus functions and connector metadata never join nets themselves; these links represent factory continuity, not field-installed jumpers.

Always connect cable-side PE (manual p.12). The required C.PE presence check can pass on the internal C.PE-M.PE link alone and does not establish an external protective-earth supply. Shared connection policy accommodates the internal representation plus one external lead, not multiple field conductors under a clamp.

Three power contacts and one PE contact (3P+PE) are supported; no neutral is present on this -407 (the 5-pole 8579/12-5.. adds N). No shield, signal, communication, auxiliary contact or additional bonding screw is verified. The protective cap (Art. No. 153261) is a separate mechanical accessory outside this type.

Compatible sockets per manual p.14: R. STAHL 8579/11, 8579/31, 8579/51, 8579/61 and DIN EN 60309 industrial sockets. Ex suitability, sealing/IP, conductor sizing, temperature class (dependent on the plug+socket combination) and mating compatibility require the installed hardware and application review. Compiler validation is not an engineering approval.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four cable-side pole endpoints and four mating pins are inventoried (3 power + PE). L1/L2/L3/earth identities come from the four-contact manufacturer drawing 19041E00 (6h front view); exact 7h physical orientation, individual screw legends and cable-clamp markings remain unverified. No neutral on this -407, and no accessory is fitted. C/M and textual PE are authoring aliases; the four fixed internal conductors are declared as fixed links.
